notes: Imported from the Rivers of London rulebook (Rogues’ Gallery / case Cast).

sheet.name: Michael Cheung
sheet.backstory: The Folly's Chinatown liaison and a legendary swordsman; short, broad-shouldered and charming, engaged to Sahra Guleed.

custom_fields.value: Michael possesses a Wizard's Sword (page 235). This sword contains a store of 20 magic points.

Unsurprisingly, seeing as he's the one teaching Sahra, the sound of ripping silk when he strikes. - *Michael's version of the Magical advantage is slightly different to that available to investigators and most NPCs, and manifests itself as the Mystic Art of Fighting (page 234)
